## FLOOWBOX - KPI Dashboard Auto-Updater
Runs every morning at 8 AM.
Fetches: daily revenue, customer metrics, product sales from Google Sheets.
Calculates: DoD change, WTD, MTD, churn, top product.
GPT-4o writes a 2-3 sentence business narrative with one action item.
Updates dashboard log sheet.
Posts daily standup to Slack every morning.
